race_key: The Creature definition key of a definition that carries authoring.profile.bestiary. A creature whose definition has no bestiary block is not a Bestiary race and is never counted.

credit.rule: A kill is credited to a character that damaged the creature at most window_ms before the creature's death.
credit.principals: The single reward principal of the death (COMBAT01-REWARD-PRINCIPALS). Multi-principal credit waits for the multi-principal reward contract.

counter.saturates_at: The last value of the race's kill_thresholds. A kill at the bound is not recorded and advances no CharacterRevision.

stages.derived: The number of the race's kill_thresholds that are less than or equal to kill_count. The entry is complete when kill_count reaches the last threshold.
